ValidationRule.description:
Annual % Increase field is required when Opp record Stage field = Approve Added Amount > 0 to make this rule only fire on positive dollar opps.
Case/Ticket: #00016021 #00016020
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Amount > 0, OR( ISNULL(Annual_Increase__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Contract_Version__c)), AND(Auto_Renew__c = True, ISNULL(Auto_Renew_Increase__c))), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Approve'), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Opportunity', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Change Order')), OR( AND( NOT( CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup__c, 'Salesforce')), NOT( CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup__c, 'Zingly')), NOT( CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup__c, 'HubSpot')), NOT( CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup__c, 'Application Solutions'))), Service_Offering_Rollup__c = ''), NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules), NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Annual % Increase, Contract Version, and Auto Renew % Increase (when Auto Renew is checked), field is required when the Opportunity record Stage field = "Approve".
